Jilong 500E Mini FTTx Fiber Fusion Splicer – Best Price in Bangladesh (2025)

Compact, High-Performance Splicing for FTTx Networks

The Jilong 500E Mini FTTx Fiber Fusion Splicer is a lightweight, efficient, and portable fiber splicing machine, designed specifically for FTTx, FTTH, and backbone fiber optic networks. Equipped with active clad-alignment technology, it delivers fast, precise splicing with minimal loss, making it the perfect tool for field technicians and fiber engineers.

Key Features 

  • Active Clad-Alignment Technology – Ensures accurate fiber alignment for low splice loss
  • Ultra-Fast Splicing & Heating – 6 sec. quick splicing & 18 sec. fast heating for maximum efficiency
  • Lightweight & Portable Design – Weighs only 1.35kg (with battery) – Ideal for fieldwork & aerial splicing
  • 3.5-inch High-Resolution Color Display – 800x480 pixel screen for clear fiber viewing
  • User-Friendly Operation – Easy-to-use interface with automatic arc & fiber identification
  • Powerful 4000mAh Battery – Supports 120+ splicing & heating cycles per charge
  • Rugged & Durable – Designed for harsh environments with dust-proof, water-resistant construction
  • Large Data Storage – Saves 10,000 splice records & 2,000 images for future reference
  • Wide Fiber Compatibility – Supports SM, MM, DS, NZDS, and G.657 fiber types


Jilong 500E Mini Fusion Splicer Technical Specifications

  • Alignment Method: Active Clad-Alignment
  • Applicable Fiber Types: SM (G.652/G.657), MM (G.651), DS (G.653), NZDS (G.655)
  • Compatible Fiber/Cable: 0.25~3.0mm, Leather Cable
  • Fiber Cleave Length: 8-16mm
  • Splicing Time: 6 sec. (SM G652 Quick Mode)
  • Heating Time: 18 sec. (Adjustable)
  • Splice Loss: SM: 0.02dB, MM: 0.01dB, DS: 0.04dB, NZDS: 0.04dB
  • Return Loss: >60dB
  • Electrode Life: 5,000 arcs (replaceable)
  • Battery: 4000mAh, supports 120+ splicing & heating cycles per charge
  • Storage Capacity: 10,000 splice records, 2,000 images
  • Tension Test: Altitude: 0~5,000m, -20°C to +50°C, Max Wind Speed: 15m/s
  • Weight: 1.06kg (without battery), 1.35kg (with battery)
  • Display: 3.5-inch high-resolution (800x480) color touchscreen
  • USB 2.0 Port – For firmware updates & data transfer
